perCaseEqualityAgainstCommitted: toolInvoked input decoded from JSON and toolName
comparisonMethod.rawProbeComparisons: Every one of eight raw probe runs is matched by exact input; direct toolsAdded/invokeTool/toolResponded data, observed outcome and DOM controls are checked, with two historical repetitions per case.
comparisonMethod.strictErrorNullCheck: For case 04, independently require actual errorText null although harness expectation null only disables substring assertion.
comparisonMethod.rawControlReencoding: All controls in this fixture are scalar inputs: map each control.name (including empty string) to control.value and require full equality to probe.observed.fields. No checkbox/radio exists in this family.
comparisonMethod.schemaSubsetVsFull: Expected schema asserts properties and required; independent comparison checks the complete observed schema including type=object across historical probes, committed receipt, and all replays.
comparisonMethod.fieldCoverage: Expected and observed fields compare exactly; disabled/readonly/hidden controls remain in the DOM inventory even though absent from tool schema.

repeatability.note: No nondeterminism observed in input/expect/status/exact errorText/fields/submitCount/full schema/command error/tool response output/guard observations across the two supported copied-layout runs; full receipt bytes differ only in listed volatile identity/time pointers.

expectationReencoding.formDataDistinction: The DOM field inventory retains disabledField and the empty-name key; completed FormData omits both. Readonly and hidden values remain in the successful output.
expectationReencoding.checkboxStringNullEncoding: Not applicable: this family fixture and all historical raw control inventories contain no checkbox/radio; no checkbox re-encoding claim is made.
expectationReencoding.agentFlagsLimitation: Historical raw unnamed probes retain agentInvoked=true and isTrusted=true. The unchanged harness receipt retains submitCount and response output, not calls/agent flags; these flags are not independently re-verified here.

findings.resolution: Parent-confirmed supported CLI used unchanged with a fresh temp parent containing regular family-only case and fixture copies. Both supported-layout replays passed.

cleanup.executionMethod: synchronous subprocess.run for every harness invocation
cleanup.harnessEnforcement: Successful main() must pass assertCleanupComplete at producer lines 1227-1231 and 1301, including no stray run-owned pids and refused former loopback port; no independent whole-host process census was performed.

isolation.note: No git writes in LANE; no tracked edits in clone. The initial throwaway clone case directory was removed. No final git status/diff verification was run.
